notes.title: Spring Cleaning Came Early!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

As I'm sure some of your have noticed, we've made a few tweaks to Wild Warfare recently! Here's what we've done:

-removed shrubs
-removed chat window
-removed server select screen

We've also made some changes to how the servers work. We found that the "Quickplay" wasn't working the way we wanted it, so we are trying something new. Here is how it works:

Overlook - Team Skirmish
Greenhouse - Skirmish
Caldera - Snail Hunter
Gulch - Capture the Flag

As always, please let us know what you think of the tweaks!

- Wild Warfare Team
